name: Carril

attributes.attribute: Carrill gives a further alternate spelling of the same name

text: The dictionary lists Carril and Carrill as two variant spellings of Cairell. A reader who meets either form should turn to the entry for Cairell. That fuller account holds the story behind this name. Carril itself carries no separate tale in the source.
